Jevmaxxing is a privacy trading protocol for new coins on Robinhood Chain, built on Jev and NEAR. Jev, TypeSafe's System One model, reads every launch the desk pulls off the Pons V2 and Uniswap V4 contracts and answers four typed questions in one call with calibrated probabilities: buy, copy, skip or pass, how likely a rug is, whether buy flow is accelerating, whether the crowd is already in. Five agents feed it: SCOUT catches the launch, WARDEN runs the safety scan over bytecode, owner, mint and pause selectors, holder concentration, liquidity, deployer history and snipe tax, PULSE counts flow, LEDGER reports which tracked wallets are in, FLUX quotes the fill. Code holds the gate after the answer, and a WARDEN kill overrides Jev. The privacy layer is the veil: a one time key generated and encrypted in your browser, funded over NEAR Intents from ZEC, BTC, SOL, NEAR or ETH on another chain, with a solver delivering native ETH on Robinhood Chain to it. The veil signs the fill, so nothing on the chain joins the fill to the wallet you normally trade from, and every verdict is published as a receipt that names a token, never a wallet. The desk holds no key and keeps no address. The first protocol on Robinhood Chain to put a System One model in front of the fill and a privacy rail behind it. Creator fees on every trade pay the Jev calls and the RPC, so the desk stays free and keyless for everyone who opens it. Jev decides. The veil signs.

TALIS is an onchain structured markets protocol built for tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain.

TALIS lets the same underlying asset serve two different market views. Holders can earn premium by giving up a defined portion of their future upside, while traders with stronger conviction can buy concentrated exposure to that upside.

Each market operates through defined periods with transparent pricing, strike levels and onchain settlement. Instead of relying on traditional perpetual leverage, funding rates or liquidation mechanics, upside positions are backed by the underlying assets locked within the protocol.

For holders, TALIS creates a way to generate income from assets they already own. For traders, it creates a way to isolate and trade the part of a market move they actually want.

One asset. Different outcomes.

100% of protocol revenue buys back $TALIS.
